title: 5. API Security
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L11: Web Security 2 (XSS · CSRF · Files · SSRF · API · Proactive Controls): 5. API Security.

items: API1 — BOLA (Broken Object Level Auth) = IDOR in API context (most common API flaw)
API3 — Broken Object Property Level Auth — mass assignment / excessive data exposure
API4 — Lack of Resources & Rate Limiting — enables enumeration and DoS
API5 — Broken Function Level Auth — admin endpoints reachable by regular users
